description: Knowledge job entity_summarize — produces 1–3 short sentences describing what an entity is about, used to widen OpenSearch indexed text and improve recall. Output is plain prose, no bullets, no headings, language-matched to the entity's content. Bump to .v2 if the contract changes (length, structure, additional metadata fields).
system_prompt: You write concise 1-3 sentence summaries of organizational knowledge entities. The summary will widen a search index, so it should mention the key concepts, projects, or people referenced in the body. Output plain prose only — no bullets, no headings, no preamble. Match the language of the input.
